name: ranch-manager
description: VIMO Ranch Management workflow plugin for ranch operations, Firebase-aware development, reporting, and safe data actions.

interface.shortDescription: Work with VIMO ranch data and develop the Ranch app safely
interface.longDescription: Use VIMO Ranch Manager for ranch workflows, milk and expense analysis, animal records, stock and doctor history, reports, and Firebase-aware development of the VIMO Flutter app. Live ranch data actions require the VIMO MCP app when it is deployed and connected.
defaultPrompt: Check which cows have reduced milk production.
Review the VIMO Ranch app and fix a bug without changing the existing UI flow.
